description: This file defines macros, base classes, and interfaces related to tensor meta functions and structured kernel implementations in the PyTorch ATen library.

classes.name: MetaBase
classes.description: Base class for structured kernel classes, providing virtual methods for setting output tensor properties and retrieving outputs.

methods.name: set_output_strided
methods.description: Virtual method to set output tensor with specific strides.

methods.name: set_output_raw_strided
methods.description: Virtual method to set output tensor with arbitrary strides.

methods.name: set_output_contiguous
methods.description: Method to set output tensor with contiguous strides, calls set_output_strided internally.

methods.name: maybe_get_output
methods.description: Method to retrieve the output tensor, defaulting to the first output.
